entities.summary: Adam Ružička is a Slovak professional ice hockey player who is currently an unrestricted free agent. He has previously played for the Calgary Flames and Arizona Coyotes of the National Hockey League (NHL), and Spartak Moscow of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL).
